The '''Scanning Patrol Detail series''' was a line of high-tech [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. The line was one of Industrial Automaton's proudest achievements, earning nearly-universal praise from the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] community. One specific model of the series was the [[Hound-W2 SPD]].<ref name="EGTD" />
